# laravelforge_site_command (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge site command run by ID, from a site's command run history.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the command run.
- `organization` (String) Slug of the Forge organization that owns the site.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server that hosts the site.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site the command ran on.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) The command that ran.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the command was created.
- `duration` (String) Duration of the command in human-readable format (e.g. `5m`).
- `status` (String) Status of the command (`waiting`, `running`, `finished`, `timeout`, `failed`).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp the command was last updated.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user who initiated the command.
